description: Backend conventions for an Umbraco package: async naming, internal by default, Attempt-based results for routine failures, public-API backwards compatibility, and where extension methods live. Use when naming a method, choosing visibility, shaping a service's result, changing a public signature (including adding a dependency to a public class's constructor), or organizing extension methods. For extension mechanisms, see `umbraco-extensibility`.
